event_chest_open.png.prompt:
A single scene illustration for a story event in a cute cartoon roguelike card game, landscape composition.

Scene: a battered cardboard box sitting on the floor on the LEFT, its top flaps just ripped wide open, packing paper spilling over its sides. A wide cone of warm golden treasure light bursts straight UP out of the open box with a few sparkles around its edges. The ninja cat hero crouches on the RIGHT beside the box, both paws still gripping one torn flap, leaning in, eyes wide and shining, mouth open in delight.

IMPORTANT COMPOSITION RULE: the inside of that cone of light must be COMPLETELY EMPTY - no treasure, no object, no coins, no glow ball, nothing floating in it. Just clean flat golden light. A game item picture will be placed there afterwards, so that area has to stay clear.

The grey tabby cat ninja hero is EXACTLY the character in the attached reference image: small grey tabby kitten, light grey fur with dark grey stripes, white chest and paws, BIG ROUND EYES, a NAVY BLUE ninja headband with two trailing tails, a dark navy ninja outfit with a dark belt, long ringed tail. Keep his face, proportions and outfit identical to the reference - same cute round-eyed design, not a different cat. Put the hero on the RIGHT side of the picture, facing LEFT toward the box.
Tell the story in one readable picture: clear staging, strong silhouettes, expressive faces, only what the
scene needs. It will be shown about 420 pixels wide, so no fine detail that disappears when shrunk.
Style: thick black outlines, flat colors with subtle soft gradients, cute cartoon storybook look,
not photorealistic. Warm torch-lit tower interior lighting unless the scene says otherwise.
No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no UI, no border.
Background must be a solid pure green (#00FF00), completely flat, for chroma keying - draw only the
characters and the few props the scene needs, standing on nothing.
Output 1024x768 PNG. Save the image as event_chest_open.png in the current directory and report the path.
